item.title: Iran and US exchange strikes on ships, escalating conflict
item.description: The weekend's exchange is the latest flashpoint in a six-month-old confrontation that began when the US and Israel struck Iran on Feb. 28, prompting Iranian retaliation against Israel, US bases and Gulf allies, and Iran's effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz — a chokepoint for roughly a fifth…

item.title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrive in Kyiv after Moscow talks in new Ukraine peace push
item.description: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv on Sunday for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, a day after holding more than three hours of discussions with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. The visit marks the envoys' first official trip to Ukraine as part of…

item.title: US strikes three Iranian oil tankers after Iran fires missiles at warships
item.description: The United States struck three Iranian oil tankers on Saturday in retaliation for Iran's ballistic missile attacks on two US warships near the Strait of Hormuz, marking a sharp escalation in the months-long conflict. item.title: U.S.-Iran tensions escalate, oil tops $90, Gulf markets mixed
item.description: Renewed U.S.-Iran attacks sent Brent crude above $90 per barrel on Aug. 31, even as American drivers faced their most expensive August at the pump on record, with an average of more than $4 per gallon every day during the month, according to AAA Fuel Prices. item.title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner meet Zelensky in Kyiv after talks with Putin
item.description: The visits mark the first direct U.S. engagement with both Moscow and Kyiv on ending the war in months, after the Trump administration's diplomatic push lost momentum during the six-month U.S. focus on the Iran conflict.
